text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Haah... Thank you for your hard work... I 
look forward to working with you tomorrow, 
too.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I read an epic about two warriors who push 
each other to greater heights. It felt 
just like watching me and Doto.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the passion still wells up within 
me...! What say you, care to break a sweat 
with me?!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees! If you're fine with me, I'd 
d-d-definitely love to join youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Can I go train with Opera O-san 
right now!?
choice_data_list: Recovering from fatigue is top priority!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! I won't let this wonderful 
invitation go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, I-I may be clumsy and 
inexperienced, but please take good care 
of meee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto gave it her absolute all and 
powered through the extra training!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, you're right... If I stay tired 
like this, I might just end up causing 
trouble. I'm so sorry, Opera O-san...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how exquisite is the tragedy of a torn 
destiny! Doto's Trainer, brilliant 
direction!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto headed home, apologizing 
profusely to TM Opera O the entire way.
